question_text:
The following table gives a number of yield strength values (in MPa) that were measured on the same aluminum alloy. Compute average and standard deviation yield strength values.

| 274.3 | 277.1 | 263.8 |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| 267.5 | 258.6 | 271.2 |
| 255.4 | 266.9 | 257.6 |
| 270.8 | 260.1 | 264.3 |
| 261.7 | 279.4 | 260.5 |

 Give your name as a tuple (mean, average).The units of each required answer are (MPa, MPa), respectively.
response:
The mean yield strength is approximately **265.95 MPa**, and the sample standard deviation is approximately **7.34 MPa**.

$$\boxed{(265.95,\ 7.34)}$$
